;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Terrorism in Indonesia]]
**[[Surabaya bombings]]
***At least 13 people are killed and more than 40 others wounded after a series of [[suicide bombing]]s at three churches in [[Surabaya]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/05/12/asia/indonesia-bombings/index.html (CNN)] [https://lfpress.com/pmn/news-pmn/bomb-attacks-at-3-churches-in-indonesia-kill-at-least-2/wcm/f0b31d02-184c-4c27-ad4b-19dbde714cda (AP via ''The London Free Press'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic policy of the Donald Trump administration]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] says in a tweet that he is working with [[President of the People's Republic of China|Chinese President]] [[Xi Jinping]] to get the Chinese telecom company [[ZTE]] "back into business, fast." ZTE suspended its main operations after the  [[United States Department of Commerce|U.S. Department of Commerce]] banned American companies from selling to the firm for seven years as punishment for ZTE breaking an agreement reached after it was caught illegally shipping U.S. goods to Iran. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/05/13/trump-says-he-and-xi-jinping-working-to-get-zte-back-into-business.html (CNBC)]

;International relations
*[[Sanctions against North Korea#United States sanctions|Sanctions against North Korea]]
**U.S. Secretary of State [[Mike Pompeo]] stated that the U.S. would lift sanctions against [[North Korea]] if the latter would dismantle its [[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction|nuclear weapons program]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-pompeo/pompeo-u-s-to-lift-sanctions-if-north-korea-dismantles-nuclear-weapons-program-idUSKCN1IE0NC (Reuters)]

**Jaspal Atwal, who was the subject of attention during [[Canada|Canadian]] [[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]]'s visit to [[India]], is charged after making death threats against a Canadian radio host. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/article-jaspal-atwal-charged-with-uttering-threats-against-bc-radio-host/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
*A man from [[Queens]] is arrested after threatening to kill [[Commissioner of the NBA|NBA commissioner]] [[Adam Silver]]. [https://nypost.com/2018/05/13/man-busted-for-sending-threats-to-nba-president-adam-silver/ (''The New York Post'')]
